source: NASA SDO/HMI synoptic magnetogram CR2300 via JSOC/Stanford
value_mapping: elev_int16 = round(sign(B) * sqrt(|B| / 1500.0) * 30000); inverse: B_gauss = sign(elev) * (elev / 30000)^2 * 1500; NaN/nodata -> 0
value_mapping_rationale: Signed sqrt compression spreads quiet-sun |B|~5G into elev~+/-700 for visible texture while strong active-region |B|~1000G map to elev~+/-24500, safely within int16 range (+/-30000 clipped to +/-32000).
